post.post_content: For fifteen years, Dr. DuPont has taught multimedia communications across the greater Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania area. Her areas of focus include VR and AR, Web design and development along with Video Game design and development. Dr. DuPont continues to provide education in these areas through her position at Community College of Allegheny County. Her passions include providing opportunities to students and members of the community to gain hands-on experience with these cutting-edge technologies and providing Open Source Educational materials to encourage others to offer opportunities to their communities.

talk_title: Equitable teaching in areas of XR
talk_description: This presentation discusses experiences and approaches to providing learning opportunities through Community Colleges. Topics include addressing obtaining hardware, preparing students for diverse workforces and obtaining funding to serve the community. The presenter also speaks about hurdles and approaches to providing affordable opportunities to students

events.session_title: Equity in Teaching Next Gen XR Developers
